title: Can the New Giant Defy Advanced still compete with Trek Domane or Specialized Roubaix in 2024???

takeaways.text: Repeats Giant's weights: Defy Advanced 860 g frame and 381 g fork, Advanced Pro the same frame with a 345 g fork, Advanced SL 785 g frame; the Advanced frame and fork are over 120 g lighter than the previous generation.
Compliance comes from dropped, thin seatstays and the D-Fuse seatpost, steerer and bar rather than suspension or a pivot; there is no down-tube storage and the bottom bracket is press-fit.
Clearance rises to 38 mm from 35 mm, with 32 mm tires fitted, which keeps the Defy a road bike rather than a gravel crossover.
The entry Advanced model was about US$3,300, with a quoted medium-large weight of 19.74 lb (about 8.95 kg).

disclosure: No relationship with Giant is stated.
summary: An overview of the 2024 fifth-generation Giant Defy Advanced frame, its compliance features, weights and clearance.
